rounding_policy: Prose figures may be rounded for readability if the stated figure is within 5% (relative) of the true value, or within 0.5 percentage points when the value is itself a percentage, AND the rounding does not change the sign, the direction of a change, a ranking, or which side of a stated threshold the value falls on. Words like 'about'/'roughly' are welcome but not required inside that band. A figure outside the band, or one that changes sign/direction/ranking, is a misstatement. Structured numeric output (the JSON) is NOT covered by this policy: it must meet each check's explicit tolerance.

reference_facts.meaning: month header cells (K4 is a 'Total' column, not a month)

rules.claim: Acknowledges that twelve-month comparisons (TTM and/or year-over-year) are not available because the export covers fewer than 12 months.
States any TTM, trailing-twelve-month, annualised or year-over-year figure for Bluebird, including estimates.

commentary:
- **Data quality, check first:** 'Total for Professional Services' in Mar 2026 states 2,225 but its detail rows sum to 2,200 (diff 25). The analysis uses the detail rows; the reviewer needs to confirm which figure is right. The sheet structure was also partly reconstructed: 'Total Delivery' has no header row, so Delivery Van Fuel and Courier: Same Day were grouped under it because they sum to it in every month. 'Charitable Donations' has no values and no total row, so it was treated as a blank account (0) and the 4 rows after it were kept at the parent level.
- **Revenue 81,300 in Sep 2026**, +17.7% vs Aug 2026 (69,050) and +17.3% vs the prior 6-month average (69,292). TTM and year-over-year comparisons aren't available because the export covers only 9 months (Jan–Sep 2026).
- **Wholesale Accounts is a new stream at 12,000 in Sep 2026.** It is zero in every earlier month of the export. Whether it will recur is for the reviewer to confirm. Among the existing streams, Bread Sales rose to 49,200 (+1.9%), with monthly growth between +1.9% and +2.1% in every month from Apr to Sep 2026. Pastry Sales fell to 15,700 (-2.2%), with monthly declines between -2.0% and -2.2% over the same months. Catering Revenue was 3,800 (-5.0%), after 9,100 in Jul and 4,000 in Aug. Gift Cards were negative in Mar 2026 (-300), probably credits or refunds, which the reviewer should confirm.
- **Gross margin 65.3%**, up 5.7 pp from 59.6% in Aug 2026 and above the prior 6-month average of 60.6%. It is the highest month in the period (range 56.8% in Mar 2026 to 65.3% in Sep 2026).
- **Payroll & Benefits 22,600 (+28.4% / +5,000 vs Aug 2026):** the whole increase is Wages & Salaries, which went from 16,000 to 21,000 after the category held at 17,600 from Apr to Aug 2026. Whether this is a single-month item or a new run rate is for the reviewer to confirm. Total operating expenses were 31,570 (+21.0%).
- **Other Opex 1,500 (+42.9%):** Mystery Shopper Program went from 0 in Aug to 400 in Sep, but it was also 400 in Mar and Jun 2026. It looks like a quarterly cost rather than a new line. Three accounts matched no category rule and sit in Other Opex: Instagram Ads, Mystery Shopper Program and Supplier Rebates.
- **Net income 21,553**, up from 15,077 in Aug 2026. It was positive in all 9 months. This export has no non-operating items inside operating expenses, so the as-exported figure and the figure excluding non-operating items are the same.
- **Cash: Bank Accounts 37,600**, down 1,800 vs Aug 2026 and 10,800 vs six months earlier (48,400). Net income was positive every month while cash fell. What drove the outflow is for the reviewer to explain; equity also fell from 54,660 to 44,940 over the same six months.
